description: This file defines the 'ZeroOrPositive' validation rule class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for API version 2. It extends an abstract validation rule and provides a validate method to check if a given input is numeric and non-negative.

classes.name: ZeroOrPositive
classes.description: Validation rule to check if a value is numeric and zero or positive, inherited from AbstractRule.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the input is numeric and greater than or equal to zero.
